hooks.command: gh issue list --state open --search "no:label" --json number,title 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | "UNTRIAGED #\(.number) \(.title)"' ; gh issue list --state open --label severity:critical --json number,title,milestone 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | "#\(.number) [\(.milestone.title // "no tier")] \(.title)"' ; gh issue list --state open --label severity:high --json number,title,milestone 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | "#\(.number) [\(.milestone.title // "no tier")] \(.title)"' | head -10 ; gh issue list --state open --limit 200 --json labels 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.[].labels[].name | select(startswith("severity"))] | group_by(.) | map("\(.[0]): \(length)") | join("  ")' || echo 'gh unavailable'
file=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts|*.css|*.html|*.json) npx --no-install prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
file=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.env*|*secret*|*credential*|*.lock|*-lock.*) echo "Protected file: $file" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
